author: The Infographics Show
description:
We were told Artemis was humanity’s triumphant return to the Moon. But the real data coming back from NASA tells a much darker story.

Artemis I recorded dangerous radiation exposure, exposed critical flaws in Orion’s heat shield, and revealed how deadly deep space still is for humans. NASA’s own reports warned some of the issues could pose significant risks to crew safety.

At the same time, the Moon is rapidly turning into a geopolitical battlefield. Both the US and China are racing toward the same resource-rich region near Shackleton Crater, where water ice and underground caves could support future lunar bases.

The Moon isn’t an empty frontier anymore. It’s becoming the next global power struggle, in one of the most hostile environments humanity has ever faced.
